name: What To Eat
overview: Scripture reveals God's provision and guidance regarding what to eat, beginning with His original design in Genesis 1:29, where He grants humanity plants and fruits for food. After the Flood, Genesis 9:3 expands this provision to include every living creature. Leviticus 11 underscores God's specific instructions about clean and unclean foods, emphasizing obedience to His commands. Meanwhile, Jesus teaches in Matthew 6:25 and 6:31 that believers should trust God's care for their physical needs and not be anxious about food or drink, recognizing that life and the body have greater significance than mere sustenance.
